description: Pi (pi.dev) session transcripts, parsed from the fixed home-relative .pi/agent/sessions root.
name: Pi
notes: Evidence: docs/providers/pi.md (transcript layout <agentDir>/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<ISO-timestamp>_<sessionId>.jsonl; record shape {type, id, parentId, timestamp, message}; usage follows OpenAI convention input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite summing to totalTokens) and src/shared/providers/pi/paths.js (fixed home-relative root; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR is deliberately NOT honoured, matching the tokscale scanner, so this pack declares no envOverrides). The bundled scanner counts only assistant message usage (docs/providers/pi.md, Invariants), hence the recordFilter; top-level usage / compaction / branch_summary / toolResult billed-operation entries that Session Detail reads are NOT in scanner totals and are deliberately excluded here so pack totals stay identical to the scan. reasoning is an informational subset of output (reasoningAdditive=false): adding it would double-count.
